graph.name: Use a dialogue voice reference
graph.description:
Propose a voice pass over paired quoted dialogue using a supplied character voice brief. Start with a single-speaker reply.

Lesson: Character voice mode and dialogue scope are independent; paired quotes define editable speech mechanically.

Limitations: Dialogue scope recognizes paired straight or curly double quotes. Review factual and tonal preservation against the supplied reference/context.

Opening makes this example the active workflow document. Bind local model roles and provide the documented evidence before running.

Post: at most 1 auxiliary calls. Preview before publishing or applying.

Try changing:
Change Cadence to measured full sentences while preserving Rin's bridge warning.
Protect unsafe and compare which quoted words remain editable.

Documentation specimen (does not seed chat or actor memory):

Before: "I disagree with your assessment. The bridge is unsafe."

After: "That bridge? No. It's unsafe."

Voice path: reply.out → revoice.in; voice.out → revoice.reference; revoice → validate → review → apply. One Prose call.

Voice is authored: Cadence/register are reference text. Dialogue scope finds paired straight/curly double quotes, not speakers; use a source containing only the intended voice.

Rin's bridge warning (reply)
Purpose: Freeze the latest completed text-only bridge-warning reply.
Fixture: Rin steadied the lantern. "I disagree with your assessment. The bridge is unsafe." She kept her boots on the near bank.
Inspect: Confirm Rin's warning and paired quotes; fixture belongs in the test chat.

Rin · practical ferry scout (voice)
Purpose: Supply Rin's practical cadence.
Inspect: Examples teach speech, not ropes or future crossings.

Revoice the quoted warning (revoice)
Purpose: Revoice only the quoted warning.
Inspect: Lantern, boots and near-bank narration stay exact.

Output tokens includes visible text and any reasoning tokens counted by the provider. A truncated result is discarded; inspect the error, then manually raise the cap and rerun. No automatic retry occurs.

Check Rin's dialogue permissions (validate)
Purpose: Validate Rin's dialogue permissions.
Inspect: Check unchanged narration, names and quote boundaries.

Listen for voice and meaning (review)
Purpose: Require a voice-and-meaning comparison.
Inspect: Read aloud: unsafe crossing remains rejected without new contempt.

Offer Rin's revised warning (apply)
Purpose: Offer Rin's revised warning.
Inspect: Full root Host result: compare the warning, then Apply or Reject.

sections.name: Cadence
sections.text: Rin uses short complete bursts in immediate danger: concrete nouns, contractions, plain refusals; decisive without insulting companions.

sections.name: Samples
sections.text: Original samples: That rope? Frayed. Take the other one. / We can cross tomorrow. I won't risk you tonight.

sections.name: Avoid
sections.text: Vary openings; That X? is not a catchphrase. Retain disagreement and unsafe bridge; add no cause or promise.

revoice.title: Style Transfer
revoice.instructions: Use Rin's practical cadence. Keep disagreement and unsafe bridge, meaning and certainty. Add no joke, threat, catchphrase or cause. Preserve narration exactly.
